author: AlexisGen
body: Okay, I already made a post about this I know. I just see a lot of people wishing the old version of Avicus was back. Where they could still play Nexus ( I know you can still play nexus) and actually try really hard to level up to show off and stuff like that, I was close to my new prestige I worked so hard at. Its also harder to communicate with my old friends now, but that's nothing to do with this does it? Someone even said they'd sign a petition 1000 times to get the old Avicus back. I think this change was for the better, and its great, but ya know how I feel? xD In CTH, kits are open to everyone which is good, I guess. Its just now, no one really has a challenge to level up anymore and that was my favorite part about Avicus, the challenge it gives you and the good feeling when you level up. Sorry if this made you upset, I know how hard the staff worked for this update. Just my opinion, thank you.  (just wanted to add, that the credits are a good thing to work torwards)

title: More opinions

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
I think the new update works better. Since it's now partially running on the EULA rules every player (even non donors) get more perks. Which is awesome! Prices have gone down, new gamemodes that everyone was ranting about a lot came. I sometimes wonder why everyone wants the updates so bad and when it comes out they ask why it's so bad xD. 
In my opinion Kylo probably felt rushed as everyone kept on saying "17 years". It doesn't feel like the update was ready to come out, but when a new update does come everyone has to expect bugs, even if it is a lot. Which is why we have the community, who tests out the almost ready plugins to finalize the tweaking to give everyone the best experience. It is a much better and efficient way instead of having a few hours of testing.
But I do agree on your opinion, that challenge has been taken out without being able to level up and that does suck but I see more pro's than cons in this update. So I am really happy about it.
Thanks for giving your opinion, it does help Kylo and Pavilion a lot when coding the plugins to make the gamemodes as entertaining for you all :)

replies.author: hpux
replies.body: It hasn't been rushed, Ivy spent 4-5 months preparing it. Almost every single thing in this update was requested by the community, and now people are complaining about it. This is what normally happens though. The next time we update, many people will be complaining about how they want this Avicus version back.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: People are always going to complain. You can't please everyone. And just because a lot of people wanted it doesn't mean everyone wanted an update.
replies.body_tagged: People are always going to complain. You can't please everyone. And just because a lot of people wanted it doesn't mean everyone wanted an update.

replies.author: AlexisGen
replies.body: Okay, so  I get that its been prepared and not rushed. Like Kycraft said, you cannot please everyone because everyone thinks different. I'm sure that a lot of people did request the update but once they played on it, maybe they had second thoughts. It's great to experiment new things like the update for example, see what people like and what people don't like.

replies.body: It just takes a little bit to adjust to new changes like the update, like you said, the next time you update people will want this update to come back. Its because people have been playing on this (new) update and when you update again, they were already probably attached to it. Good job though for putting in the community's ideas. I hope this makes sense ._.
